inlines.v: ASSORT', verb transitive [See Sort.] 1. To separate and distribute into classes things of the like kind, nature or quality, or things which are suited to a like purpose. It is sometimes applied to persons as well as things. 2. To furnish with all sorts. ASSORT', verb intransitive To agree; to be in accordance with; to suit.
